name: Stovetop Ratatouille with Puy Lentils
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) Puy or green lentils, cooked
1 red bell pepper and 1 onion, diced
3 tomatoes, chopped, and 1 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp dried thyme and 1 tsp herbes de Provence
steps: Heat 1 tsp oil and brown the eggplant for 6 minutes; set aside.
Heat the remaining oil and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and herbs.
Add the zucchini, tomatoes, tomato paste and ½ cup water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Return the eggplant and stir in the lentils; simmer for 8 minutes.
note: Lentils turn the vegetable stew into a complete meal.
